rerun_note: The essay's firsthand experiments were originally run on 2026-06-24; that harness lived in a gitignored tmp/ dir and was deleted after publish per the finite-disk policy. Because this is a pure-local Node benchmark with zero external dependencies and the host still runs the exact recorded Node build (v24.15.0), the harness here was re-authored from the recorded methodology and RE-EXECUTED on 2026-08-08 (KST 2026-08-09). probe-result.json is that genuine re-run's output — not a reconstruction. It reproduces every contract the post claims (v16 ignores the signal; v17 throws AbortedGraphQLExecutionError; cooperative vs orphan child work; cancel != rollback; the 7 diagnostics channels; error.abortedResult).

environment.runner: plain Node, single process, no network / DB / GPU
environment.note: This checks execution-engine cancellation, cleanup, and observability CONTRACTS (throw-vs-resolve, event ordering, channel payloads), not throughput. CPU/GPU/RAM do not change the pass/fail; the millisecond timings are recorded as context only.

subject.name: graphql
subject.api: execute({ abortSignal }), info.getAbortSignal(), AbortedGraphQLExecutionError (named export), error.abortedResult, graphql/diagnostics (node:diagnostics_channel tracingChannel)
subject.note: v17 adds cooperative cancellation and a diagnostics_channel observability surface that v16 lacks entirely.

baseline.name: graphql
baseline.note: Exercised firsthand as the A/B baseline: execute() silently ignores an abortSignal and exposes no info.getAbortSignal / AbortedGraphQLExecutionError.

dependency_pinning.method: npm aliases in package.json — graphql-v16=npm:graphql@16.14.2, graphql-v17=npm:graphql@17.0.1 — so both versions load in one process.
dependency_pinning.why: Pinning exact versions (not ^ or latest) keeps the contract outcomes reproducible; a future graphql minor could change timing or add fields.

raw_artifacts.retention_policy: none discarded — all evidence is small text and committed
raw_artifacts.note: No large or binary artifacts. node_modules is gitignored and not committed. The deterministic evidence is probe-result.json (event orderings + contract outcomes), regenerable by run.sh on the pinned versions.
